## Import Data

```{r}
# read data and delete v1
data4 <- read.csv("data_ca4.csv")
data4 <- data4[, !(names(data4) %in% "v1")]

# Combine categories (v5 and v21)
table(data4$v5)
data4$v5[data4$v5>1] <- 0
table(data4$v5)

table(data4$v21)
data4$v21[data4$v21>0] <- 1
table(data4$v21)
```

## Exercise 4:1.1

```{r}
# fitting multiple logistic regression model
m_empty <- glm(v2~1, family = binomial, data= data4) # empty model
m_full <- glm(v2~.,family = binomial, data= data4) # full model
summary(m_full)
summary(m_empty)
```

```{r}
# stepwise model selection using AIC
mstep1_AIC <- step(m_empty, direction = "forward", scope = list(upper = m_full), trace = TRUE)
mstep2_AIC <- step(m_full, direction = "back", trace = FALSE)
mstep3_AIC <- step(m_full, direction = "both", trace = FALSE)
summary(mstep2_AIC)
summary(mstep3_AIC)
AIC(mstep1_AIC, mstep2_AIC, mstep3_AIC)
```

```{r}
# stepwise model selection using BIC
mstep1_BIC <- step(m_empty, direction = "forward", scope = list(upper = m_full), k=log(nrow(data4)), trace = FALSE)
mstep2_BIC <- step(m_full, direction = "backward", k=log(nrow(data4)), trace = FALSE)
mstep3_BIC <- step(m_full, direction = "both", k=log(nrow(data4)), trace = FALSE)
summary(mstep1_BIC)
summary(mstep2_BIC)
summary(mstep3_BIC)
BIC(mstep1_BIC,mstep2_BIC,mstep3_BIC)
```

```{r}
# OR and CI
exp(cbind(OR = coef(mstep1_AIC), confint(mstep1_AIC)))
# exp(cbind(OR = coef(mstep2_BIC), confint(mstep2_BIC)))
```

## Exercise 4:1.2

```{r}
# HL test
predprob_AIC <- predict(mstep1_AIC, type = "response") #Obtain predicted probabilities for the full model
# install.packages("ResourceSelection")
library(ResourceSelection)
hoslem.test(data4$v2, predprob_AIC, g=10)
```

## Exercise 4:1.3

```{r}
# build confusion matrix
pred01_AIC <- ifelse(predprob_AIC > 0.5, 1, 0) #Binary classification, cut-off=0.5
confmatrix <- table(1-data4$v2,1-pred01_AIC)
dimnames(confmatrix) <- list(Actual = c("Not-survive","Survive"), Predicted = c("Not-survive","Survive"))
confmatrix
```

```{r}
# check
table(data4$v2)
table(pred01_AIC)
tab1 <- addmargins(confmatrix)
tab1
```

```{r}
# calculate metrics
accuracy1 <- (tab1[1,1]+tab1[2,2])/ tab1[3,3]
sensitivity1 <- tab1[1,1]/ tab1[1,3]
specificity1 <- tab1[2,2]/ tab1[2,3]
cat("Accuracy under cut-off 0.5 is",accuracy1,"\n")
cat("Sensitivity under cut-off 0.5 is",sensitivity1,"\n")
cat("Specificity under cut-off 0.5 is",specificity1,"\n")
```

```{r}
cuts <- c(0.5, 0.3, 0.7)

for (c in cuts) {
  cat("Cut-off:", c, "\n")
  
  pred01_AIC <- ifelse(predprob_AIC >= c, 1, 0)
  confmatrix <- table(1-data4$v2,1-pred01_AIC)
  dimnames(confmatrix) <- list(Actual = c("Not-survive","Survive"), Predicted = c("Not-survive","Survive"))
  print(confmatrix)
  
  tab <- addmargins(confmatrix)
  accuracy <- (tab[1,1]+tab[2,2])/ tab[3,3]
  sensitivity <- tab[1,1]/ tab[1,3]
  specificity <- tab[2,2]/ tab[2,3]
  cat("Accuracy under cut-off", c, "is",accuracy,"\n")
  cat("Sensitivity under cut-off", c, "is",sensitivity,"\n")
  cat("Specificity under cut-off", c, "is",specificity,"\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Exercise 4:1.4

```{r}
# ROC for full model
library(pROC)
predprob_full <- predict(m_full, type = "response")
roc(data4$v2, predprob_full)
plot(roc(data4$v2, predprob_full),legacy.axes = TRUE,main = "Full Model")
```

```{r}
# ROC for two other models
predprob_step1AIC <- predict(mstep1_AIC, type = "response")
predprob_step1BIC <- predict(mstep1_BIC, type = "response")
roc(data4$v2, predprob_step1AIC)
plot(roc(data4$v2, predprob_step1AIC),legacy.axes = TRUE, main="AIC model")
roc(data4$v2, predprob_step1BIC)
plot(roc(data4$v2, predprob_step1BIC),legacy.axes = TRUE, main="BIC model")
```

The full model performs best based on AUC.

## Exercise 4:1.5

```{r}
# LOOCV for full model
predprob_LOOCV <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(data4), ncol = 3)

for (i in 1:nrow(data4)){
  # create training and validation sets
  data_training <- data4[-i,]
  data_validation <- data4[i,,drop= FALSE]
  
  # fit the model on the training data
  m_full_l <- glm(v2~., family = binomial, data = data_training)
  mstep1_AIC_l <- glm(v2~ v3 + v7 + v11 + v14 + v17 + v18 + v21, 
                      family = binomial, data = data_training)
  mstep1_BIC_l <- glm(v2~ v3 + v7 + v14 + v21,
                      family = binomial, data = data_training)
  
  
  # predict the value for the held-out observation
  predprob_LOOCV[i,1] <- predict(m_full_l, newdata = data_validation, type = "response")
  predprob_LOOCV[i,2] <- predict(mstep1_AIC_l, newdata = data_validation, type = "response")
  predprob_LOOCV[i,3] <- predict(mstep1_BIC_l, newdata = data_validation, type = "response")
}

roc_full <- roc(data4$v2, predprob_LOOCV[,1])
roc_step1AIC <- roc(data4$v2, predprob_LOOCV[,2])
roc_step1BIC <- roc(data4$v2, predprob_LOOCV[,3])

roc_full
roc_step1AIC
roc_step1BIC
```

## Exercise 4:2.2
```{r}
data4$v2 <- as.factor(data4$v2)
```

```{r}
# choose the good decision tree
# information, cp=0.07
tm_infor007 <- rpart(v2 ~.,method = "class", data=data4, parms = list(split = "information"), cp = 0.07)

# Get predicted probabilities
predprob_tm <- predict(tm_infor007,type = "prob")[,2]

# calculate AUC
library(pROC)
roc(data4$v2, predprob_tm)
plot(roc(data4$v2, predprob_tm),legacy.axes = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Compare with logistic regression models
# Decision tree model AUC
roc_tree <- roc(data4$v2, predprob_tm)
auc_tree <- auc(roc_tree)

# AIC model AUC 
roc_AIC <- roc(data4$v2, predict(mstep1_AIC, type = "response"))
auc_AIC <- auc(roc_AIC)

# BIC model AUC
roc_BIC <- roc(data4$v2, predict(mstep1_BIC, type = "response"))
auc_BIC <- auc(roc_BIC)

# Print AUC results for comparison
print(paste("Decision Tree AUC:", auc_tree))
print(paste("Logistic Regression AIC Model AUC:", auc_AIC))
print(paste("Logistic Regression BIC Model AUC:", auc_BIC))

# Plot comparison of ROC curves
plot(roc_tree, col = "blue", lwd = 2, legacy.axes = TRUE)
plot(roc_AIC, col = "red", lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
plot(roc_BIC, col = "green", lwd = 2, add = TRUE)

# Add legend
legend("bottomright", legend = c(
  paste("roc_tree (AUC =", round(auc_tree, 3), ")"),
  paste("roc_AIC (AUC =", round(auc_AIC, 3), ")"),
  paste("roc_BIC (AUC =", round(auc_BIC, 3), ")")
), col = c("blue", "red", "green"), lwd = 2)
```

## Exercise 4:2.3

```{r}
# Leave-one-out cross-validation, AUC
predprob_LOOCV <- numeric(nrow(data4)) # Create a vector for the predicted values

for (i in 1:nrow(data4)) {
 # Create training and validation sets
 data_training <- data4[-i,]
 data_validation <- data4[i, ,drop=FALSE]

 # Fit the model on the training data
 tm1 <- rpart(v2 ~.,method = "class", data=data_training, parms = list(split = "information"), cp = 0.07)

 # Predict the value for the held-out observation
 predprob_LOOCV[i] <- predict(tm1, newdata = data_validation, type = "prob")[,2]
}


roc(data4$v2, predprob_LOOCV)
plot(roc(data4$v2,predprob_LOOCV),legacy.axes = TRUE,print.coords = TRUE)
```
